sources.title: Fine-tuning SmolVLA for Cube Pick-and-Place on SO-101
sources.snippet: Context # For the past few months I've been exploring different algorithms for my SO-101 robot arm to do a pick-and-place task. Last time I trained SAC with HIL-SERL (Human-in-the-Loop Sample Efficient RL) on the real robot with a reward classifier and human interventions via the leader arm. After about 750 episodes of training, HIL-SERL achieved 80% success on reach-and-grasp. That's good ...

sources.snippet: Model Card for smolvla SmolVLA is a compact, efficient vision-language-action model that achieves competitive performance at reduced computational costs and can be deployed on consumer-grade hardware.

sources.title: Fine-tune SmolVLA with the recorded SO-101 demonstrations
sources.snippet: Run fine-tuning You'll fine-tune the SmolVLA model with the SO-101 demonstrations that you recorded. Fine-tuning adapts the model to your two camera views, robot joint layout, and pick-and-place task. Training runs locally on the DGX Spark GPU and produces a model checkpoint for physical evaluation.
